regime_read: Convergence fire is brightest in AI/semis (NVDA/AMAT both 6/5-convergence, congress + analyst + github/patent alignment) but the retail/affiliate-heavy AI names (PLTR, META) are already extended; the actionable edge concentrates in the lagging semis left behind by the AI move, where insider momentum (MU) and legislation (memory-chip act) independently line up.
regime_read_zh: AI/半导体（NVDA/AMAT 均达 5~6 路收敛，国会+分析师+GitHub/专利对齐）的收敛信号最亮，但零售/关联型 AI 股（PLTR、META）已严重超买；可操作优势集中在被 AI 行情甩下的落后半导体，其内部人动能（MU）与立法（存储芯片法案）独立共振。

theses.thesis: Applied Materials shows 5-way convergence (analyst_upgrade_cluster, congress_cluster, news_sentiment, patent_cluster, unusual_options) with congress net +4 across 4 members holding ~$52.0M, analyst bull 0.97, news bull 0.86, and 293 patents — yet it is rs_vs_spy_60d -37.3pp (not extended). The second-order beneficiaries are the lagging semis tied to the Memory Chip Competitiveness Assessment Act (HR10170) and the AI data-center buildout this pack points to elsewhere (NVDA). This is accumulation on weakness, not momentum-chasing.
theses.thesis_zh: 应用材料呈现 5 路收敛：分析师上调聚簇、国会买入聚簇、新闻情绪、专利聚簇和异常期权；国会净买入 +4，4 位议员持仓约 5200 万美元，分析师看多比 0.97，新闻看多比 0.86，专利 293 项——而相对标普 60 日落后 37.3 个百分点（未超买）。第一层间接受益者是与《存储芯片竞争力评估法案》（HR10170）以及本数据包指向的 AI 数据中心建设（NVDA）关联的落后半导体。这是逢低布局而非追涨。
second_order: MU: same memory/semis bill (HR10170) adds legislative tailwind, and earnings in 5 days may crystallize insider momentum
LRCX: direct semis-pick-and-shovel peer not named in pack; benefits if AMAT's capex read is real
NVDA: AI-fab demand that fuels AMAT's deposition/etch orders is the same demand driving NVDA GPU capex
evidence: unusual_options: vol/OI 0.611, put/call 1.07 (calls unusually elevated toward a laggard)
theses.dissent: Congress clusters are disclosed lagged holdings and analyst upgrades are often reactive; a 60-day -37pp outlier can mean the market has already priced a structural drag on legacy deposition/etch. The elevated put/call of 1.07 is slightly bearish on the options axis, so this may be a value trap.

falsifier.text: Semiconductor equipment cycle stalls — AMAT's orders or peer bookings show sequential decline over two quarters despite AI capex, and congressional disclosed positions rotate out within 90 days.

theses.thesis: Micron shows 5 convergence points with an insider_mspr of 100 (insider momentum at full strength, no selling) against a -9.4pp relative lag, plus a maxed Stocktwits bull ratio 1.0 on 213k watchers and a CNBC pick. Crucially the pack carries the Memory Chip Competitiveness Assessment Act (HR10170, Semiconductors, introduced 2026-08-27) and MU reports earnings 2026-09-30 — 5 trading days out. The evidence aligns on an idiosyncratic catalyst window rather than broad AI chase, which is why it is actionable even before earnings.
theses.thesis_zh: 美光呈现 5 个收敛点：内部人 MSPR 满分 100（内部买入动能最强、零卖出），而相对大盘落后 9.4 个百分点；Stocktwits 看多比拉满至 1.0（21.3 万关注）；加上 CNBC 选股。关键在于数据包中出现了《存储芯片竞争力评估法案》（HR10170，半导体，2026-08-27 提出），且美光将在 2026-09-30 公布财报——距今仅 5 个交易日。证据在独特催化剂窗口上对齐，而非追逐 AI 贝塔，因此即便在财报前也可视为可操作。
second_order: AMAT: MU's HBM/memory capacity expansion is fabrication demand for AMAT's etch/deposition tools
SMH theme: broad semis (NVDA, AMD not in pack) ride the same memory/AI pricing cycle
WDC: memory-competitiveness bill reads broadly to storage/memory peers if CHIPS-style support extends
theses.dissent: Earnings in 5 days is a binary event; the -9.4pp lag may reflect an expected pricing cliff in NAND/DRAM and the hot retail posture (bull ratio 1.0) means reflexive downside if guidance disappoints. The insider_mspr of 100 is trivially true for many names absent insider selling and may not signal active buying.

falsifier.text: Micron guides third-quarter memory pricing or bit-shipments below consensus in the 2026-09-30 report, or the memory-chip bill stalls in House after introduction and is never marked up.

theses.thesis: Nvidia carries the richest actor map in the pack — Nancy Pelosi, Marjorie Taylor Greene, and Michael McCaul all openly hold stakes [actor: Pelosi, Greene, McCaul], Jensen Huang CONTROLS, and Jim Cramer TALKS_ABOUT — with 6 convergence points (affiliation, analyst_upgrade_cluster, github_momentum, patent_cluster, retail_buzz, special_situation). The catch: the name is not lagging (rs_vs_spy_60d +9.4pp, not extended but not cheap) and retail attention is already huge (207 WSB mentions). It is a regime anchor, not an entry. I mark it WATCH rather than accumulate because the edge is in shadow beneficiaries, not the obvious name.
theses.thesis_zh: 英伟达拥有数据包中最为密集的议员网络：佩洛西、格林、麦考尔均公开持股 [actor: Pelosi, Greene, McCaul]，黄仁勋为实控人，Jim Cramer 公开谈论——收敛度 6（关联、分析师上调、GitHub 动能、专利聚簇、散户热度、特殊事件）。但问题在于：该股并不落后（相对标普 60 日 +9.4 个百分点，不算超买但也不便宜），且散户关注度已极高（WSB 提及 207 次）。它是行情的锚，而非入场点。标记为 WATCH 而非累积，因为边际优势在影子受益者而非显性标的。
second_order: AMAT: NVDA GPU demand translates to wafer-fab equipment demand (deposition/etch)
MU: HBM (high-bandwidth memory) is co-bottleneck with NVDA AI GPUs
SMCI: NVDA-server integrator already extended — theme confirms but avoid the name itself
theses.dissent: The actor map is backward-looking (disclosed positions) and a 9.4pp premium means a lot of the AI leadership is already in the price. WSB mentions at 207 with a hot GitHub footprint mean crowded-trade risk if the AI capex narrative bends.

falsifier.text: Nvidia's hyperscaler AI-capex orders show signs of front-loaded digestion — customers lengthen depreciation, delay mainstream GPUs beyond HBM-constrained pods, or disclosed politicians trim positions.

theses.thesis: Palantir has 6 convergence points and a gov_contract_accel of 0.83, but every behavioral flag here is a caution: rs_vs_spy_60d +62.1pp (extended: true), Trump side 'sell', the only disclosed actor is Marjorie Taylor Greene HOLDS_STAKE — a highly volatile political bet, not a smart-money signal — and stocktwits_bull is maxed at 1.0 on 324k watchers (peak retail crowding). The retail heat drowns any edge. Avoid.
theses.thesis_zh: Palantir 有 6 个收敛点且政府合同加速 0.83，但这里每一项行为信号都是警告：相对标普 60 日 +62.1（extended: true），特朗普侧为卖出，唯一披露的关联者是格林（HOLDS_STAKE）——这是高波动政治押注而非聪明钱信号；Stocktwits 看多比在 32.4 万关注上拉满至 1.0（散户拥挤度到顶）。散户热度淹没了任何优势。Avoid。
second_order: Defense/AI software peers: C3.ai, BBAI — same government AI-cohort trade rides PLTR's hot narrative if it unwinds
MSFT: government-AI partnership read (Altman PARTNERS_WITH) — large, liquid beneficiary without the meme beta
theses.dissent: The consensus bear case on PLTR has been wrong persistently; gov_contract_accel 0.83 above threshold is genuine operational momentum, and defense-software giga-trends can keep a crowded name riding higher than fundamental gravity suggests.

falsifier.text: PLTR's government contract acceleration rolls over (accel falls below ~0.5 sequentially) or the pair of crowded retail actors begins churning down Stocktwits watcher count as government contract wins slow.

theses.thesis: Meta is extended (+35.2pp vs SPY) with trump_side 'buy' (often a contrary flag in this pack) and double-president contention flags (Zuckerberg CONTROLS duplicated). The only genuine signal is massive product demand (73.2M HF downloads/30d, 250k GitHub stars, 601k watchers). But a 35pp premium plus a 0.67 stocktwits bull ratio (mildly skeptical retail) means you are paying for the AI story that is already reflected. Avoid.
theses.thesis_zh: Meta 已超买（相对标普 +35.2pp），特朗普侧为买入，但复制条目标记（扎克伯格 CONTROL 重复出现）暗示数据质量问题。唯一真实信号是巨大的产品需求（30 日 HF 下载 7320 万、GitHub 星 25 万、关注者 60 万）。但在 +35pp 溢价加上 Stocktwits 看多比仅 0.67（散户温和怀疑）的背景下，你是在为已经反映在价格里的 AI 叙事买单。Avoid。
second_order: AMAT/MU: META's data-center/AI spend is a buyer of compute/memory chip capacity
Broadcom (AVGO): custom ASIC silicon for META's AI workloads, unnamed in pack
theses.dissent: META's AI infrastructure spend and massive installed base could keep investor flows in mega-cap quality names even with stretched valuations; a 35pp premium in a mega-cap is not as extreme as in PLTR.

falsifier.text: Meta guides data-center/AI capex down sequentially or Zuckerberg's control-role disclosure reveals a governance overhang that reprices the name lower despite high app demand.

theses.thesis: Super Micro has retail_buzz (373 WSB mentions — second-highest in pack) and unusual_options showing put/call 0.29 (very bullish call skew) but insider_mspr only 30.2 (insider selling alert) and rs_vs_spy_60d +38.5 through extended territory. The dissociation is violent: insiders sell while retail crowds buy calls. That is not a long-side convergence; it is a distribution setup. Avoid.
theses.thesis_zh: Super Micro 的散户热度（WSB 提及 373 次——数据包内第二高）和异常期权显示看跌/看涨比 0.29（极度看涨倾斜），但内部人 MSPR 仅 30.2（内部人卖出警报），且相对标普 60 日 +38.5，进入超买区间。分歧极其剧烈：内部人在卖，散户在抢筹码。这不是多头收敛，而是派发结构。Avoid。
second_order: NVDA: SMCI AI-server pass-through to NVDA GPUs — same demand, cleaner actor set
MU/AMAT: AI-server buildout pulls memory and wafer-fab equipment demand
theses.dissent: The AI-server segment has genuine earnings volatility, and a put/call 0.29 can persist if hyperscaler orders keep surprising; SMCI's past accounting resets may now be behind it.

falsifier.text: SMCI's retail call-buying unwinds — options put/call spikes back above 0.5 while insider_mspr falls below 20, showing insiders accelerate sales into fading retail flow.

track_record.calibration_note: No theses scored yet — the track record begins once the first check-by dates pass. Keep conviction modest until it does.
track_record.calibration_note_zh: 尚无判断被评分 —— 待首批核查日到期后开始累积战绩；在此之前置信保持克制。
track_record.note: Alt-data brain theses graded vs SPY. The actionable axis is calibrated by this track record; conviction defers to it.
